summary: An app's preferences as one large dialog over the page it was opened from, on its own route (principle 9): a head with the title and a close; the sections in a column under their group titles, with a search over every setting at its top; the shown section's rows beside it, scrolling on their own; and a footer with Reset to defaults for the shown section, a note that changes are kept as they are made, and Done. Below 768 it fills the screen, and the column is a list of sections to go into.

sokkel-ui-egui: crates/core/src/widgets/settings.rs (SettingsDialog, SettingsSection, SettingsWords, SettingsOutcome, setting_row, setting_row_found_by)

anatomy.box: The dialog's box (parts/dialog) with no padding of its own, its 1px border-strong edge and elevation-dialog under it: 896 wide and 704 tall, at most the window less 32 across and 64 down. The page under it is shaded by the dialog's backdrop. Below 768 it is a full-screen sheet, with no edge or shadow.
anatomy.head: 48 tall across the box under a rule: the title at its start, the close at its end; on a phone in a section, Back before the title.
anatomy.title: words.title, in the heading face.
anatomy.close: An icon-sm ghost button at the head's end, named words.close; it closes the dialog.
anatomy.back: On a phone in a section: an icon button before the title, named words.back, back to the list of sections.
anatomy.column: The navigation, 224 wide at the box's start under a rule at its end, scrolling on its own: the search, then each group's sections under its title, 16 apart. Named words.title.
anatomy.search: A search field over every setting: words.search as its placeholder, named words.searchLabel, cleared by words.clear. It narrows the column to the sections with a match and the pane to the matching rows.
anatomy.groupTitle: A group's title over its sections, small and muted; a group may have none.
anatomy.entry: A section in the column: its optional icon and its label, cut short. The shown one is marked; on a phone each is a finger tall with a chevron at its end, and none is marked.
anatomy.chevron: On a phone, at an entry's end: a chevron, faint.
anatomy.pane: The shown section, scrolling on its own: its heading, its lead, its rows and its foot; words.noMatch when the search leaves nothing.
anatomy.heading: The shown section's heading, or its label.
anatomy.lead: A section's own line above its rows: what the whole section is for.
anatomy.row: One setting (SettingRow): its title, what it does under it, and its control at the row's end while the row is at least 512 wide, else under its words; a note under both. Rows are ruled apart.
anatomy.rowDescription: What a setting does, under its title.
anatomy.rowNote: A line under a setting on the muted ground: what it needs, or what it changes elsewhere.
anatomy.rowRule: The rule between two rows; none over the first or under the last.
anatomy.foot: A section's own line under its rows: a refusal, where else these settings apply.
anatomy.noMatch: words.noMatch, muted, in the pane (and in the column on a phone) when the search leaves no setting.
anatomy.footer: Under the column and the pane, outside their scroll: the band of parts/dialog's footer, on the muted wash under a rule. Reset to defaults at its start, the note, and Done at its end.
anatomy.reset: Reset to defaults (words.reset), a ghost button at the footer's start. It asks once more, a ConfirmDialog (parts/dialog), before it resets the shown section, or every setting with resetScope all. Left out while the shown section says reset: false.
anatomy.saved: The footer's note: words.saved, or the app's own (footer), announced as a status.
anatomy.done: Done (words.done), a default button at the footer's end, which closes the dialog.

open.does: Shown over the page: on #/settings, drawn by the shell's route.

groups.does: The sections under their group titles: [{ id, title?, sections: [{ id, label, icon?, heading?, lead?, foot?, settings: [{ id, title, description?, note?, control, layout?, keywords? }], reset? }] }]. Data, the same on every target.

active.does: The shown section's id; the first section with a match is shown while the search leaves the chosen one none.

phoneStart.does: Which view a phone opens on: the list of sections, or the shown section.

footer.does: The footer's note in place of words.saved: when the settings last synced.

onReset.does: Adds Reset to defaults, which asks once more and then gets the shown section's id, or nothing when resetScope is all.

resetScope.does: What Reset to defaults puts back: the shown section (principle 9), or every setting, which shows on a phone's list too.

sectionReset.does: A section's reset: false leaves Reset to defaults out while it is shown, for a section with nothing to put back (an account, sample data). Only a section reset reads it.

layout.does: Where a setting's control sits: trailing in a column at the row's end, level with the title, for a switch or a small button; below under the description, for a wide control; auto trailing while the row is at least 512 wide, else below.

keywords.does: More words a setting is found by, never drawn: logout for Sign out, dark for the scheme.

box.note: parts/dialog's box with no padding; at most the window less 32 across and 64 down (layout).

head.note: On a phone it pads 8 at its start.

close.note: parts/button, ghost, at icon-sm; a 16 icon.

column.note: The whole width on a phone. The search is a control tall (parts/text-field).

entry.note: 34 tall from 768: 6 over and under a 22 line; 2 apart (layout). A finger tall below 768, where the column is a list.

row.note: gap: between the words and a trailing control.

footer.note: 65 tall at regular: 16, Done's density.control, 16, and its 1px rule; 61 at compact.

windowRoom.note: The box is at most the window less this wide.

heightRoom.note: The box is at most the window less this tall.

groupTitleBelow.note: Under a group's title, before its first entry's 2.

entryGap.note: Between a group's title and its entries, and between entries.

headingBelow.note: Under the section's heading, over its first row's 16.

descriptionTop.note: Between a setting's title and its description.

controlTop.note: Over a control placed under its words.

trailingFrom.note: The row's own width from which auto places its control at the end (a container query).

phoneBelow.note: Below this window width (768) the dialog fills the screen and the column is a list of sections to go into, at the dialog's own line (parts/dialog).

phoneHeadStart.note: The head's start pad on a phone.

sectionsBetween.note: Between the search and the first group, and between groups.

routes.settings: #/settings: the dialog over the page it was opened from (principle 9). Back, Done, the close or Escape returns to that page; a link opening the app on #/settings draws the app's home under it.

rest.means: Open over the page on the shown section.

searching.means: The search holds words: the column keeps the sections with a setting that holds every word in its title, description, keywords, or its section's label or heading; the pane shows the shown section's matching rows, or the first section left.

shown.means: The entry of the section in the pane.
shown.reached: active, or the first section a search leaves

noReset.means: The shown section says reset: false: the footer leaves Reset to defaults out and keeps the note and Done.
noReset.reached: a section with reset false, under a section reset

confirming.means: Reset to defaults was pressed: a ConfirmDialog asks words.resetSection (or words.resetAll) with words.resetSectionDetail under it, words.resetConfirm as a destructive answer and words.cancel; the settings dialog is shaded under it (parts/dialog, nested).

phoneList.means: Below 768, on the list: the column fills the screen, each entry a finger tall with a chevron, none marked; a section reset is left out.
phoneList.reached: a window below 768, phoneStart list, or Back

phoneSection.means: Below 768, in a section: the pane fills the screen, with Back in the head.
phoneSection.reached: a window below 768, phoneStart section, or an entry chosen

rest.note: parts/dialog's box: a 1px border-strong edge and elevation-dialog under it; below 768 a sheet with neither.
In the heading face, the box's ink.
The rule along its end, from 768; no ground of its own.
parts/dialog's footer band; its rule along its top.

keyboard.does: Moves from the search through the entries, the pane and the footer, held inside the dialog.
Shows that section; on a phone, goes into it.
Closes the dialog: on #/settings, back to the page it was opened from.
keyboard.when: no layer is open over it

words.title: Settings
words.saved: Changes are saved as you make them
words.resetSectionDetail: Every setting in {section} goes back to its default.
words.resetAll: Reset every setting to its default?
words.resetAllDetail: Every setting in every section goes back to its default.

resetSectionDetail.says: Every setting in General goes back to its default.

appText.groups: Every group's title, every section's label, heading, lead and foot, and every setting's title, description, note and keywords.
appText.footer: The footer's own note, in place of words.saved.

sokkel-ui: The app holds open, active and search; useOverlayRoute (hooks/use-overlay-route) draws the dialog on #/settings over the page it was opened from, and closing goes back through the history.
Base UI's Dialog through the dialog primitives, with the dialog's box, its sheet below breakpoint-md (SHEET) and its footer.
From 768 the search takes focus on opening; on a phone or a foldable the view in sight does, so no keyboard rises.
The pane is keyed by the shown section, so a new section starts at its top.
A row's auto layout is a container query on the row (@lg, 32rem).
On a phone the footer pads its foot by the home indicator's inset (env(safe-area-inset-bottom)).
SettingsNavList draws the same sections beside a settings page on the rail's ground (ground sidebar), the shown one in the rail's accent; that page is not this part.
sokkel-ui-egui: SettingsDialog::new(id, sections, &mut active).words(..).show(ctx, rows) returns SettingsOutcome { close, reset }; rows draws a section's rows with setting_row or setting_row_found_by.
Settings is open state the app holds, not a route: egui has no URL, and Back is the app's back stack.
The dialog holds its search itself and clears it on closing.
theme_settings draws the appearance rows every app shares.
